x: Our thanks and good wishes to JACK OLIVER on his retirement to the Portsmouth area. Jack was of considerable service to us as a walking judge for many years.

It was left to Pat O'Connor to show the flag in 5th place to confirm his gradual return to fitness and to Keith Sinclair to put in a good time on this long and tedious '10'. 1.J.Oliver (Camb) 54.10; 5.P.O'Connor (Bel) 56.15; 20.K.Sinclair (Bel) 60.06. 22.C.Henn 60.32; 33.
